initializer_settings.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B with analytic marginal-likelihood gradient
initializer_settings.output: area only; same initial semantic output center and scale
initializer_settings.selection: lowest finite completed-fit negative historical log marginal likelihood; earliest exact tie
initializer_settings.accept_nonconvergence: finite completed fits remain eligible; all statuses/warnings retained
initializer_settings.failure: all three starts always attempted; no eligible finite fit raises ARDInitializationError
initializer_settings.post_optimizer_validation: one extra likelihood evaluation at the returned parameters; separately counted
initializer_settings.target_usage: public prediction only; no target labels or target-conditioned optimization

finite_settings.utility: positive improvement in verified whole-program cycle reduction
finite_settings.update: fixed initial preprocessing and kernel; noisy-observation Gaussian conditioning
finite_settings.device: common Beta(1,1) fit rate updated on complete successful paid/fantasy flags
finite_settings.horizon: two-step receding horizon; exact myopic acquisition on final query
finite_settings.unknown_failure_probability: unmodeled; actual attempts charged without numerical update
finite_settings.tie: acquisition, immediate expected gain, analytic cycle reduction, seeded public order
finite_settings.fallback: only on final query with no improving verified feasible incumbent; original latency/cost tuple

historical_accounting.scope: Frozen original ten-case historical cohort ledger only; not all project costs after additional source collections.

primary.endpoint: Best verified feasible whole-program cycle reduction and measured-pool regret
primary.source_units: Old/expanded AHA/NDES/MD5 macros separately; DCT, Expint and bitcount separate.

preparation: Seal every ARD joint/marginal/snapshot package and deterministic normal table before parsing native outcomes.
real_update: Original immutable JointHardwarePosterior conditioning; no estimator or hyperparameter refit inside search.
optimizer_selection: Historical marginal likelihood only, never target labels or selection utility.
limitations: One area-surrogate specification changes covariance family, ARD and historical likelihood fitting together; this does not isolate their individual effects.
All scored sources are consumed development data. Ten cohort/source cases span six sources; seeds, caps, budgets and repeated cohorts are dependent.
The historical 99-label/102-attempt ledger is the frozen original-cohort scope, not all project costs after subsequent source collections.
Only the existing myopic acquisition is evaluated with the new initializer. There is no model, kernel, prior or policy sweep.
Every model fit uses only its original cached historical cohort. New paid observations never cross cases; all update parameters and preprocessing stay fixed after initialization.
Gaussian observation noise, known analytic benefit and the common Beta device model are assumptions; probabilities are not calibrated confidence.
Three deterministic optimizer starts are selected solely by finite historical marginal likelihood; nonconvergence and bound hits remain visible.
Strongest archived control is a retrospective reporting envelope selected within each case/cap/horizon, not a deployable target-label-aware selector.
All seventeen controls are copied exactly. Earlier fourteen-policy B1/B2 controls are prefixes of their horizon-independent three-query searches.
Native ledger costs are reused and overlap across policies/cohorts. Host timers, initialization, original setup and recorded native costs are distinct scopes.
No G723 artifact or outcome is read. Its frozen live policy is outside this experiment.
No new native jobs, fresh-source result, promotion, calibrated-confidence or field-superiority claim.
